name: paperless.avado.dnp.dappnode.eth
title: Paperless-ngx (documents)
shortDescription: Turn your paper letters, bills and contracts into a searchable archive
description: Your own paperless office. Scan or photograph letters, bills and contracts, and Paperless reads the text, files them and makes every word searchable, all on your AVADO. Getting started: open Paperless; the first time, it asks you to create your account (this first account can manage everything). Then drag PDF files or photos onto the page. Paperless reads English by default; for German, French, Italian or Spanish documents click the link "Document language" below, change PAPERLESS_OCR_LANGUAGE to deu, fra, ita or spa (or, for example, deu+eng for both) and press "Update environment variables" (the app restarts by itself, your documents stay). Reading a document takes a few seconds to a minute and runs at a lower priority than the Ethereum node. Any device that can open my.ava.do (at home on the AVADO network, or away through Remote Access) can use it.
author: AVADO
